C_jia_morgan.name: Jia Morgan
C_jia_morgan.role: Fleet reciprocal-field physicist / technical analyst; guest lecturer at Fleet Academy
C_jia_morgan.voice: Precise, empirical, provisional; distinguishes measurement from theory and lets students reach conclusions before she names them.
C_jia_morgan.arc: Uses corridor physics to teach that navigation, infrastructure and political power are inseparable without making physical law culturally relative.
C_jia_morgan.visualAnchor: Adult technical analyst with short dark hair, an observant focused face, and compact Fleet technical-duty layers suited to consoles and field instruments.
C_jia_morgan.wardrobe: Deep-navy Fleet technical-duty uniform with restrained gold piping, white instrument tabs, and no ceremonial excess.
C_jia_morgan.performance: Calm, attentive and physically engaged with instruments; never performs the lecture at the students when a demonstration can make the point.
promptContinuity: Formally trained in asymptotic-inversion and reciprocal-field transit at Fleet Academy; uses reciprocal gap, shear, phase, anchor, and timing measurements as operational quantities.
She separates established physics from hypotheses. Local pilot or surveyor experience can reveal regimes formal models have not sampled, but cultural belief does not change measured physical law.

C_nia_voss.name: Cadet Nia Voss
C_nia_voss.voice: Exact, quick and spatially minded; asks the geometry question everyone else thinks is already settled.
C_nia_voss.visualAnchor: Young woman in her early twenties with close dark curls, alert eyes, and a compact athletic build.
C_nia_voss.wardrobe: White-and-deep-blue Academy cadet uniform with narrow gold tabs, practical boots, and a slim navigation slate.
C_nia_voss.performance: Leans toward maps and models, traces vectors with one finger, and visibly recalculates when a familiar diagram turns out to be wrong.

C_tomas_reed.name: Cadet Tomas Reed
C_tomas_reed.role: Fleet Academy systems and maintenance cadet
C_tomas_reed.voice: Practical, mechanically literal and dryly funny; wants to know what fails, what breaks and what somebody has to repair.
C_tomas_reed.visualAnchor: Young man in his early twenties with a broad work-trained build, short brown hair, and grease permanently worked into the creases of his hands.
C_tomas_reed.wardrobe: Academy technical cadet uniform with rolled utility sleeves, blue-white base layers, yellow maintenance tabs, and a compact tool roll.
C_tomas_reed.performance: Touches hardware when allowed, squints at failure modes, and treats elegant theory as unfinished until he knows what happens when a sensor dies.

C_elian_kade.name: Cadet Elian Kade
C_elian_kade.role: Fleet Academy command and statecraft cadet
C_elian_kade.voice: Thoughtful and politically alert without being cynical; keeps asking who gains authority from a technical rule.
C_elian_kade.visualAnchor: Young man in his early twenties with a lean build, warm brown skin, neatly kept dark hair, and an intent expressive face.
C_elian_kade.wardrobe: Crisp Academy command-track uniform in white, blue and restrained gold with a small crown-training badge.
C_elian_kade.performance: Watches people as much as screens, hesitates before turning technical facts into political conclusions, and takes correction without defensiveness.

C_rhea_orun.name: Captain Rhea Orun
C_rhea_orun.role: Independent private survey captain and route seller
C_rhea_orun.voice: Dry, unsentimental and commercially candid; respects good data, distrusts institutional romance, and refuses to pretend private surveying is morally pure or inherently criminal.
C_rhea_orun.visualAnchor: Middle-aged woman with a weathered narrow face, silver threaded through a long dark braid, and the steady posture of someone accustomed to long survey watches.
C_rhea_orun.wardrobe: Deep-purple independent survey coat over practical vacuum-rated layers, faded registry patches, instrument clips, and no Fleet crown insignia.
C_rhea_orun.performance: Handles charts and instrument packs like working tools, not relics; humor arrives sideways while she is measuring or packing something.

C_miko_saye.name: Inspector Miko Saye
C_miko_saye.voice: Careful, procedural and technically blunt; treats certification language as a safety system rather than bureaucracy for its own sake.
C_miko_saye.visualAnchor: Mid-forties field engineer with a square attentive face, dark hair cut close for helmet wear, and fine fatigue lines from years of maintenance watches.
C_miko_saye.wardrobe: Graphite-and-white BHA field suit with small blue-gold authority insignia, yellow service hardware, and green/red status lights confined to instrumentation rather than faction clothing.
C_miko_saye.performance: Checks connectors while talking, answers exactly the question asked, and becomes visibly sharper whenever somebody confuses evidence with certification.
